name: Crowley JAXPORT Terminal Office #4 - Jacksonville FL

fieldNotes.siteIdentification: 2085 Talleyrand Ave = Crowley Port Office #4 (roster geocode movedMeters 370). Confirmed by imagery: the southern RoRo/vehicle section of the Talleyrand terminal - a vast automobile staging yard (thousands of vehicles in rows), a large riverside transit-shed warehouse, and breakbulk/car-hauler operations. Office #4 handles Car Haulers, Motorcycles, Individual Vehicle Shippers. Same physical terminal as idx 1 (2831) and idx 3 (3001).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed - the consolidated modernized covered multi-lane terminal gate, seen from inside in interior Street View (gantry cranes behind it, auto-storage rows alongside). Web directions: 'turn left to 2085 where the gate will be on the right.'
fieldNotes.guardShack: Booth/check-in structures at the covered gate canopy; staffed port gate (TWIC access control).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Multi-lane covered gate canopy; ~3 inbound / ~2 outbound assigned; exit split low confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide covered multi-lane gate with ample apron - room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large riverside transit-shed warehouse with loading doors on its faces; ~15 estimated, banded 10-25, low confidence (port transit shed, not a standard cross-dock).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Vehicle-staging RoRo cargo is the dominant 'drop' use - thousands of cars in marked rows, plus trailer/container storage; banded 50+.
fieldNotes.scale: Talleyrand terminal advertises 3 scales; set true consistent with the multi-lane gate, flagged uncertain (not individually resolved).
fieldNotes.multiStep: Multi-lane gated check-in with canopy booth and likely in-lane scaling - staged process.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs run alongside Talleyrand Ave into the terminal (visible at z20).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus-scale terminal: gate complex, transit-shed warehouse, multiple auto-storage yards, offices.
